product_summary: Manufacturer of colour pigments and dyes for six end-markets: (1) cosmetic colours & pigments (organic and inorganic, surface-treated pigments, coloured micas, pearl/mica pigments, natural colours, metallic effect pigments, lake pigments, chromium hydroxide green, carbon black, titanium white); (2) soap & detergent dyes — non-staining liquid dyes and water-soluble dyes for homecare; (3) colouring agents and pigments for pharmaceuticals; (4) colours for food & beverages (synthetic food colours, lake colours); (5) colours for pet food & animal feed; (6) pigments for coatings, plastics and printing inks. Own manufacturing units at GIDC Vapi and Sarigam (Valsad, Gujarat) plus an innovation/application lab in Andheri, Mumbai; claims 45+ years and distribution to 65+ countries. Source: koelcolours.com homepage and contact page (product menu: Cosmetic Colours & Pigments, Soap & Detergent Dyes, Coloring Agent in Pharmaceutical & Pigments for Pharmaceuticals, Food Beverages Pet Food Coloring & Pigments, Cosmetic Technologies, Specialised Metallic Color Pigments, Cosmetic Mica Pigments & Powder, Natural Colours; product dropdown: Pigments for Cosmetics, Speciality Ingredients for Cosmetics, Speciality Pigments for Pharma/Food/Petfood, Pearl Pigments for Cosmetics and Food & Pharma, Non-Staining Liquid Dyes for Homecare, Water Soluble Dyes for Homecare).
comment: Declared set 320412/320417/320419/320710 is directionally correct but incomplete and partly mis-aimed. 320417 (synthetic organic pigments) is the core line and is corroborated by the site's organic pigment / lake colour / cosmetic pigment ranges — exact. 320412 (acid dyes) and 320419 (other synthetic organic colouring matter) are plausible for the soap & detergent / homecare dye lines but the site names no specific dye chemistry (no 'acid', 'direct', 'reactive', 'basic' wording), so these are only partially corroborated — the homecare range is described as 'non-staining liquid dyes' and 'water-soluble dyes', which could equally sit in 320413/320414/320416/320419. 320710 (prepared pigments/opacifiers for ceramics, enamelling, glass) is NOT corroborated anywhere on the site: no ceramics, glass or enamel product line is offered, so this code looks like a wrong/legacy line — wrong. Missing from the declaration: 320500 (colour lakes — the site explicitly discusses lake pigments in confectionery and offers lake colours), 320611/320619 and 320649 (titanium dioxide and other inorganic/effect pigments — the site offers pearl/mica pigments, metallic effect pigments, carbon black to pure white, chromium hydroxide green), 320300 (natural colours — a named product line), and 3204xx food-colour codes for the food/beverage and pet-food ranges. Industry label 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas and chemicals) is a misclassification of the sub-sector: this is a specialty colourants/pigments and dyes manufacturer (organic & inorganic pigments, dyes, lakes, effect pigments) with no oil & gas activity shown — the 'chemicals' half is right, the 'oil & gas' half is not supported. No trader signs found: own GIDC manufacturing units in Vapi and Sarigam, own lab, own brand ranges, US patent claim for 'Altered Karbon' — consistent with manufacturer, not trader. Per project rule 3, the HS discrepancies (notably the uncorroborated 320710 and the missing 320500/3206xx/320300 lines) are NOT grounds for rejection: company is retained and the code list should be corrected to the actual pigment/dye/lake/effect-pigment range. All product claims above are from the company's own website only — no customs line or shipping record was checked in this task, therefore every product line here is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' (declared, not confirmed) at the shipment level; the existence of the product range itself is corroborated by the site's own catalogue pages, but export/delivery actuality is outside this task's scope and remains unverified.
